title: Hidari Yokoyama Launches Ayaru's Brush with Romance Manga
content: Manga creator Hidari Yokoyama launched a new manga titled Ayaru's Brush with Romance ( Ippitsu Ayaru ) on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service on Sunday. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is releasing the manga in English simultaneously.
author: ANN

title: NYCC Hosts Voice Actor Hikaru Midorikawa, Shonen Jump+ EIC Yuta Momiyama, More Guests, Events, Anime Premieres
content: New York Comic Con is listing the following Japanese guests and events for its 2026 convention: • Voice actor Hikaru Midorikawa ("ONE‑PUNCH MAN Special Panel: The Voice of Garou" on October 10 at 1:30 p.m.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Just Confirmed the Coolest Straw Hat Once Again, and No One Comes Close
content: One Piece continues to develop its story in the Elbaph arc, and its latest chapter has once again highlighted why one Straw Hat is still the coolest in the crew and the entire series. The Elbaph arc has, in particular, emerged as an interesting arc, giving many new characters the spotlight.
author: ComicBook

title: New Gundam TV Anime Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO Scheduled for April 2027
content: Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO , the brand-new TV anime directed by Kenji Kamiyama, will officially premiere in April 2027. The series is part of the newly unveiled RG Project , which was previously announced earlier this year during San Diego Comic-Con 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Pokémon Developer Game Freak Announces Ame nochi Hare Onna Mobile Game
content: GAME FREAK Inc. announced on Monday a new mobile game titled Ame nochi Hare Onna ( Girl After the Rain) , which will launch for iOS and Android in Japan this winter. The company revealed the game's teaser promotional video, key visual, and main character and cast members.
author: ANN

title: New Ranma 1/2 Anime's Season 3 Reveals 3rd Promo Video
content: The staff for the third season in the new anime based on Rumiko Takahashi 's Ranma 1/2 manga revealed the third promotional video for the anime on Monday. The video previews the opening and ending theme songs for the season.
author: ANN

title: 'Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content: The official website of the Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. ( Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion ) television anime revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, the main visual (pictured), and promotional video on Monday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Web Manga 'Funsou deshitara Hatta made' Gets TV Anime
content: Publishing company Kodansha announced a television anime adaptation of Motohiro Den 's Funsou deshitara Hatta made ( If It's a Conflict, Leave it to Hatta ) web manga on Monday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: To You in the Beyond Anime Film Reveals Character Videos
content: The staff of To You in the Beyond , the anime film of Akiko Abe 's Doko Yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e novel, revealed a compilation of six character promotional videos on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eight Ending Featuring "CYCLE" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eight ending, featuring the song “CYCLE” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 90-101, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner
